The list is empty. In “Only for listed sites” mode, no links can open apps.
The list applies only in “Only for listed sites” mode. Switching modes keeps your saved sites.
Rules check the site a link leads to, including after redirects. The site where you tap the link does not grant permission. Each rule covers all pages on the destination site and its subdomains.
Phone, email, SMS and other links without a web destination can open apps only in “Allow” mode. This includes Call, Send message and Add to contacts in the link menu.
When app navigation is blocked, Argon opens the web version of the link if available. Rules also apply to Open in app, private tabs and Argon tabs opened by other apps.
